title: Cold rebuild: From payload to principal
summary: Rebuild From payload to principal from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **From payload to principal** in *The pieces: schemes, principals and policies*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

code: var claims = new[] { new Claim("sub", "ada"), new Claim("role", "editor") };
steps.explain: No authentication type means not authenticated. And the first identity uses the default role claim type, so a claim literally named `role` doesn't count as a role there.

steps.title: Rebuild From payload to principal cold
prompt: Write `ClaimsPrincipal ToPrincipal(string payloadJson)` that turns a (validated) JWT payload into a principal:
- one `Claim` per property, with the property name as type and the value's `ToString()` as value (`"exp": 2000` becomes `"2000"`),
- an array becomes **one claim per element** (`"role": ["admin", "user"]` gives two `role` claims),
- the identity has authentication type `"Bearer"`, name type `"sub"`, role type `"role"`.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
Type the shape yourself, then fill it in:
